preflight_finding: Source inspection found that the independent package reaper selected expired deadlines only. Cancellation before the deadline depended on queue workers.
correction: Include cancelled nonterminal custom jobs in the independent cleanup query. A focused regression and the full backend suite passed before cloud checks; no published scientific result is attributed to this defect.
operational_controls: Pause the existing queue-poll EventBridge rule only when no queued/running production jobs exist; keep the independent reaper schedule enabled. Use a deterministic service-only release actor, explicitly not a Google identity, and private operational studies with no fabricated model reviews. Restore queue polling in all terminal paths.
deadline_interpretation: Measure terminal host state relative to its saved deadline. A terminated host proves host cleanup; it does not identify whether the guest timer, runtime sampler or independent reaper acted first. Preserve unavailable runtime receipts as missing.
resource_bounds: Original three-host maximum and per-host 900-second ceiling are unchanged. Normal/deadline cases use 300 seconds, cancellation uses 900 seconds. No automatic retries or model calls. Failure leaves custom admission disabled.
conditional_gap: Admin service operational checks do not establish a legitimate Google browser action or live model answer quality.
